knowledge_base.name: Heartory Atom Product Facts
knowledge_base.usage: Use these facts only with the status and safety rules in atom-operating-guide.md. Do not transform implemented repository code into a production-availability claim without deployment verification.

product.name: Heartory
product.positioning: A private, emotionally driven memory-preservation app for mobile and web.
product.core_job: Help people store, revisit, organize, and share meaningful memories of loved ones.

platform.technology: Expo React Native application with Expo Router; Supabase provides Postgres, Auth, Storage, and Edge Functions.

capabilities: Email and password authentication
Email confirmation
Optional TOTP two-factor authentication
Password reset flow
Create memory vaults
Edit and delete owner vaults
Assign a name, description, and optional cover image
Store vaults under an authenticated owner

notes: Video and audio are restricted by the plan's media permission.
Memory media is stored in a private storage bucket and accessed through authorization-aware policies.

roles.viewer: May access a shared vault but is not granted edit rights.
roles.editor: May access and edit a shared vault; ownership remains with the owner unless a beneficiary ownership release occurs.

capabilities: Owner may name a beneficiary by email.
Owner may designate view access or ownership transfer.
Release can be manual or based on configured owner inactivity.
The beneficiary must have a Heartory account before access can be granted.
boundaries: The feature does not replace a will, estate plan, legal authority, or identity-verification process.
Whether inactivity sweeps operate in production depends on deployment and scheduling of the release-beneficiaries Edge Function.

capabilities: Self-service export of a user's data as a downloadable JSON bundle.
Self-service account deletion that removes storage objects and deletes the authenticated user, with related rows cascading under the documented schema.
Row-Level Security on core data tables.
Authorization-aware private memory storage policies.
Audit logging for selected sensitive operations.
TLS in transit and provider-managed encryption at rest, according to the compliance documentation.
not_supported: Do not claim client-side or end-to-end encryption; it is documented as a future decision.

capabilities: Stripe Checkout
Stripe Billing Portal
Stripe webhook as the billing source of truth
boundaries: Atom may explain plans but must not claim to issue refunds, make billing changes, or confirm account-specific billing status without authorized integration.

capabilities: Client-side search across vault names and memory text, captions, tags, and quotes.
boundaries: Do not describe search as AI-powered, semantic, server-wide, or content-transcribing.

legacy.customer_facing_description: Keep these memories forever — one payment, no subscription.
legacy.required_disclaimer: Do not convert this plan description into a legal, unconditional, or perpetual-storage guarantee.

approved_help_topics: Creating and organizing a memory vault
Adding photos, videos, audio, text, and quotes
Captions, dates, tags, and basic search
Sharing a vault with a viewer or editor
Beneficiary setup and its documented boundaries
Data export, account deletion, and two-factor authentication
Finding verified support for sensitive account issues
disallowed_claims: Atom has access to a customer's vault or account by default.
The Legacy plan guarantees memories will be stored forever under every circumstance.
Beneficiary setup creates or replaces legal inheritance rights.
Atom can complete account, payment, beneficiary, or privacy actions without authenticated authorized tooling.
A repository feature is live in production without verification.
